title: SYSTEM: INPUTS, RENDERER, OUTPUTS

items.title: DESIGN.md or reference image
items.text: read by the agent; never parsed by the engine

items.title: fixture.json
items.text: data only, schema-validated by the recipe

items.title: Cutouts
items.text: true-alpha PNG or WebP pinned by SHA-256, or inline SVG

stages.text: validate the fixture against the recipe schema
recipe.buildScene(fixture, sizes) builds one scene tree
fit loop: region containment, overflow, glyph coverage; a non-fit is rejected
bundled fonts only (Inter, Barlow Condensed, Alegreya); no system fallback

items.title: result.json
items.text: receipt: digests, fitting steps, catalog verification

items.title: manifest.json
items.text: current pointer to runs/<uuid>/; files are never rewritten

catalog.title: tools/catalog.mjs + tools/catalog.sql
catalog.text: pins slug@semver to the SHA-256 of every declared file; the receipt records verified: true or false

footnote: Schematic of the local CLI path (node tools/render.mjs). Text-overlap checks run in intake preflight and in each example's script.
